{{Quote|We are the Vagaari. We take what we want.|The Miskara|<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
The '''Vagaari''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they conquered and ruled over a [[Vagaari Empire|considerable area]], mainly as slavers. They were led by the [[Miskara]]. Their traditional dress usually included robes of ornate and elaborately-designed fabrics and materials; they wore large masks intended to compensate for their height, which was somewhat shorter than the average human.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Speech is for drones and prey. The conversation of warriors is in their actions.|Estosh|<ref name="SQ" />}}
The Vagaari were short beings with stubby legs and four-toed feet, but with comparatively large hands and large, violet eyes; their ears rose high on their heads, and they had tan skin. They had two mouths, each with two sets of small teeth. They also carried with them strange and unique creatures such as [[wolvkil]]s and [[schostri]], which they used as weapons.<ref name="SQ" /> Although relatively primitive, the Vagaari had highly developed suspended-animation technology, and were able to make effective use of captured [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction fields]]. Vagaari starships utilized [[living shield]]s, made of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings imprisoned in [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]-like plastic bubbles mounted on the outside of the ship’s hull, making most enemies unwilling to engage for risk of killing innocent beings.<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)" />

Males and females had separate, but equally important, roles in the Vagaari Empire. Males dominated the soldier, pilot and politician castes; the female Vagaari made up the castes responsible for invasion strategy, sanitation and torture.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|They were a great race of nomadic conquerors and slavers who once flew freely through this region of space, taking and destroying at will, particularly among the smaller species and worlds.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ" />}}
The Vagaari were enemies of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], yet official [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] policy never officially labeled them so. Vagaari began moving through Chiss space around [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]. A large number of them were destroyed by the then [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Commander Thrawn]] at the destruction of the ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. After that they retreated to their own corner of the Unknown Regions, building up forces for an eventual attack on the Chiss. The Chiss were aware of this buildup and feared that they had "already made alliances with powers even more dangerous than they are."<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)" />

The Vagaari disguised themselves as peaceful [[Geroon (species)|Geroons]] in an attempt to destroy [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]], which housed the survivors of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] expeditionary fleet, the [[Outbound Flight Project|Outbound Flight project]]. The supposed [[wolvkil]] skins they wore were actually alive, and used to attack the Chiss. After their leader [[Estosh]] was killed, the battle was lost. Following this failed attack, a state of war officially existed between the Ascendancy and the Vagaari.<ref name="SQ" />

The Vagaari found new allies in the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], aiding the aliens in preparing their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They began incorporating [[biot]]s around [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]]. After the Yuuzhan Vong invasion had ended, the Vagaari benefited from the chaos and death the aliens had wrought and subjugated territory.
